ticker_news.title: Better Electric Vehicle (EV) Stock: Lucid vs. Tesla
ticker_news.description: The article compares the performance of Tesla and Lucid, two electric vehicle companies. It suggests that Tesla is a better investment option due to its continued production and profitability, while Lucid is facing challenges with increasing losses and lower production rates.
ticker_news.author: Chris Neiger

ticker_news.title: 1 Spectacular Growth Stock That Could Join Nvidia, Tesla, Apple, and Others in the $1 Trillion Club
ticker_news.description: This article discusses a growth stock that is expected to experience a surge in revenue, profit, and cash flow in the upcoming years, potentially joining the ranks of companies like Nvidia, Tesla, and Apple in the $1 trillion club.
ticker_news.author: Parkev Tatevosian, Cfa
